title: The lowest-calorie cheeses

seo.title: Lowest-calorie cheeses: ranking per 100 grams
seo.meta_description: 1% cottage cheese is about 72 calories/100 g and part-skim ricotta 138, versus ~254 for part-skim mozzarella, 264 for feta and ~400 for cheddar.
seo.search_intent: Compare cheeses by calories on an equal-weight basis and understand how moisture and fat drive energy density.

excerpt: Very moist, reduced-fat fresh cheeses dominate the low-calorie end. A USDA 1% cottage reference has about 72 calories/100 g and part-skim ricotta 138, compared with about 254 for part-skim mozzarella, 264 for feta and roughly 400 for cheddar.
content_html:
Cheese calories are driven largely by water and fat. The wetter and lower-fat a cheese is, the fewer calories it usually packs into 100 g.

Representative values per 100 g

CheeseCaloriesFatProtein
1% cottage cheese~72~1 g~12 g
Part-skim ricotta~138~7.9 g~11.4 g
Part-skim mozzarella~254~15.9 g~24.3 g
Feta~264~21.3 g~14.2 g
Cheddar~400~33 g~25 g

The gap between 1% cottage and cheddar is close to 330 calories per 100 g, reflecting major differences in both water and fat.

Aging concentrates calories

As cheese loses water, its fat and protein become concentrated into a smaller weight. That is why aged cheeses can be much more energy-dense even when people normally eat smaller portions.

Protein does not track calories perfectly

Part-skim mozzarella provides about 24.3 g protein/100 g—roughly twice the ~11.4 g in part-skim ricotta—but also about 116 more calories per 100 g.

Check the actual product

Cottage, mozzarella and other cheeses come in full-fat, reduced-fat and fat-free versions. The package label is more accurate than a single category average.

Bottom line

Low-fat cottage cheese and part-skim ricotta are especially low in calories per 100 g. Aged cheeses are more concentrated, so serving size matters too.

faq.question: What cheese has the fewest calories?
faq.answer: Among common references, 1% cottage cheese is about 72 calories per 100 g.

faq.question: Is ricotta low in calories?
faq.answer: Part-skim ricotta is about 138 calories/100 g, versus roughly 254 for part-skim mozzarella.

faq.question: Why is cheddar high in calories?
faq.answer: It contains much less water and about 33 g fat/100 g, concentrating energy.
